item.title: Boston Scientific Neuromodulation Corporation: Nalu TD2 Therapy Disc with firmware, REF: 34014-001, and TD2 Patient Kit, REF: 74011, part of the Nalu Neurostimulation System Recall
item.product: Nalu TD2 Therapy Disc with firmware, REF: 34014-001, and TD2 Patient Kit, REF: 74011, part of the Nalu Neurostimulation System
item.summary: Therapy Disc (TD) that powers and sends stimulation signals to an Implantable Pulse Generator (IPG), part of a neurostimulation system, has a firmware issue that causes the TD to attempt to restart, then fail, leading it to become non-functional, and if a secondary TD is unavailable, this may lead IPG to become non-functional, thus unable to inhibit transmission of pain signals. Product details: Nalu TD2 Therapy Disc with firmware, REF: 34014-001, and TD2 Patient Kit, REF: 74011, part of the Nalu Neurostimulation System
item.affectedPeople: US Nationwide distribution in the states of PA, FL, OR, AZ, OH, SC, TX, OR, OK, MI, CA, NJ.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
